The two concrete HTTP exporters honor standard endpoint configuration, but their unconfigured v1.45.0 defaults are https://localhost:4318/v1/traces and https://localhost:4318/v1/metrics with HTTP/protobuf. No receiver was discovered, so compatibility with a local Studio receiver is unverified.

finding_inventory.title: Keep trace export off the settlement path
finding_inventory.gap: newProvider installs sdktrace.WithSyncer(exporter). The installed SimpleSpanProcessor calls ExportSpans synchronously from each Span.End, so ending ledger.write can stall settle and inflate the enclosing settle.batch duration. The existing Shutdown calls are present; they are not a missing-lifecycle defect.

finding_inventory.title: Measure settlement duration by outcome
finding_inventory.gap: settlement.batches counts the single startup settlement in serve, and settle.batch provides individual trace timing. There is no duration histogram for comparing settlement latency by success or failure. The normal main path always selects failed=false; the explicit failure branch exists only as a callable source seam.

limits: Six synthetic source applications share Go/Python provider bootstrap templates; this is not a representative sample of independent production repositories.
Two repetitions per app/version and six application clusters; confidence estimates are exploratory.
A degenerate bootstrap interval when all observed applications tie does not establish equivalence or rule out differences on future applications.
Both fresh grading sessions use the same model as the task. Version labels are withheld, not an independent human or different-model assessment.
Only frozen declared predicates enter primary F1. SDK environment-resource behavior was already examined and is excluded from primary scores.

Every report finding is reviewed for material factual support, including extra findings. Unresolved premises are not proof of an incorrect finding. Grading does not receive all audit-generated sidecar evidence or prove each proposed fix.
SDK probes execute actual application functions with in-memory SDK sinks/readers. They do not prove HTTP transport, OTLP delivery, all lifecycle interleavings, or cloud receipt.
Explicit command-path guards do not prove hermetic isolation, authenticated provenance, or absence of all possible indirect reads.

Raw source/report/grade/capture artifacts remain at the recorded local workspace and are bound by hashes; the published ledger contains findings, grades and SDK evidence, not all complete canonical reports.
This experiment disables native and skill-workflow telemetry export. CLI evaluation records are not Studio OTel skill usage or provider-token telemetry.
